|death = {{ne|1000}}}}'''Annah''' was a foot soldier and messenger from the [[White Tower]] army during the [[Last Battle]].

== Appearance ==
She was a heavyset young woman.

== History ==
Annah used to be a merchant's guard.

== Activities ==
During the battle in [[Kandor]], Annah was sent by [[Gareth Bryne]] to the [[Seanchan]] [[Empress]] to lend the White Tower army some cavalry.

When she was on her way to the [[Traveling]] ground, a fireball knocked a ''[[raken]]'' from the sky, landing in Annah's way and crushing her as it rolled.

[[Min Farshaw]] replaced her and delivered the message.

== Trivia ==
Annah is named for Anna Roberts, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
